meta.review_notes: Strict re-analysis: privacy policy is severely outdated (October 2020). Four categories are unknown because the policy is silent on camera/microphone, contacts, storage/file access, and health/biometric data. The policy explicitly states extensive data sharing with advertising networks, social media platforms, and analytics providers. Extensive device and behavioral tracking is described. Data retention is vague. Some user rights exist but are limited.

app.name: BookMyShow | Movies & Events
app.description: India's largest online ticketing platform for movies, events, plays, sports, and activities.

verdict.one_liner: BookMyShow's privacy policy has not been updated since 2020 and states that your data may be shared with advertising networks and social media platforms.
verdict.summary: The policy states that BookMyShow collects extensive computer and usage data including your device information, browsing behavior, and transaction details. It states that your data may be shared with advertising networks, social media platforms, and analytics providers. The policy was last updated in October 2020 and does not clearly explain how long data is kept. The policy is silent on several data categories including camera, contacts, storage, and health data.
verdict.recommendation_reason: BookMyShow's privacy policy has not been updated since 2020 and states that your data may be shared with advertising networks and social media platforms. Consider the privacy trade-off before creating an account.

red.title: Privacy policy has not been updated since October 2020
red.plain_english: The policy states it was last updated in October 2020. It may not reflect current practices.

red.title: Shares data with advertising networks and social media platforms
red.plain_english: The policy states that BookMyShow may share your data with advertising networks and social media platforms for selecting and serving relevant adverts, and with search engine and analytics providers.

red.title: Tracks what you view, click, and search for
red.plain_english: The policy states that BookMyShow collects the pages and videos you view, how long you spend on them, what you search for, what you click on, and the services you use.

red.title: Vague data retention policy
red.plain_english: The policy states that BookMyShow retains personal data for 'a variety of legitimate legal or business purposes' but does not clearly explain exactly how long or what those purposes are.

green.title: Payment data is protected by PCI DSS certification
green.plain_english: The policy states that BookMyShow is PCI DSS certified, which means the data you submit is secured according to globally accepted data security standards.

green.title: You can opt out of marketing emails
green.plain_english: The policy states that you can unsubscribe from receiving marketing information at any time by using the unsubscribe function within the electronic marketing material.

green.title: You can request updates to your personal data
green.plain_english: The policy states that you may update your personal data by contacting helpdesk@bookmyshow.com.

green.title: Dedicated customer grievance and data protection officer
green.plain_english: The policy states that BookMyShow has a Customer Grievance Officer who also serves as the Data Protection Officer for GDPR purposes.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The policy states that BookMyShow collects your device location and the state or country you access the site from, but it does not clearly explain whether this is precise GPS or general location.
categories.detail: The policy states it collects 'cookies and the ID and location of your device' and 'the state or country from which you accessed Bookmyshow.' It also mentions 'other geographic and demographic information.'

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: The policy states that BookMyShow shares your data with advertising networks, social media platforms, search engines, analytics providers, payment processors, event organizers, and cinemas.
categories.detail: The policy states: 'We may share your data with advertising networks and/or social media platforms for the purposes of selecting and serving relevant adverts to you via those networks/platforms, and to search engine and analytics providers.' It also shares with ultimate entertainment providers for verification and service delivery.

categories.detail: The policy states it collects 'the services you use and the manner in which you use such services (ex: the content you access, view, click on, search for, transact etc.)' and shares data with advertising networks and social media platforms.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The policy states that you must be over 18 to make a transaction, but it does not describe any age verification system.
categories.detail: The policy states: 'A transaction on Bookmyshow is to be conducted by persons above the age of 18 years only. If you are under 18 years of age, you are not allowed to make a transaction in Bookmyshow.' It says it is the duty of legal guardians to supervise, but does not describe any verification mechanism.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: The policy states that you can request updates to your data and opt out of marketing, but data retention periods are vague and based on 'legitimate legal or business purposes.'
